Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd. is a specialized chemical enterprise located at 233 Zhenxing Road, Kenli County, Dongying, Shandong Province, China. Benefiting from the region’s strong petrochemical and industrial base, the company integrates product development, production coordination, and international trade to serve customers in both domestic and overseas markets.

ZhaoRui focuses on supplying a wide range of chemical products tailored for use in industries such as coatings, plastics, rubber, water treatment, oilfield services, and general industrial manufacturing. By working closely with qualified production partners and maintaining strict quality control standards, the company aims to provide stable, consistent product performance that meets or exceeds relevant industry specifications. Emphasis is placed not only on product quality but also on reliability of supply, flexible packaging options, and responsive technical support.

With a trade-oriented mindset, Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd. pays particular attention to logistics efficiency, export documentation, and regulatory compliance, helping customers reduce procurement risk and streamline their supply chains. The company is committed to long-term cooperation, focusing on transparent communication, competitive pricing, and timely delivery.

Leveraging its strategic location in Dongying—an important hub within China’s chemical and petrochemical sector—ZhaoRui continues to expand its product portfolio and service capabilities. Its goal is to be a dependable partner for customers seeking professional chemical sourcing solutions, practical technical guidance, and stable business relationships in an increasingly demanding global market.
